qa_pairs.question: What button number is used to adjust the SI?
qa_pairs.answer: The SI can be adjusted with button (10).

qa_pairs.question: How long does the SI run off at intervals when pressing button 10?
qa_pairs.answer: The SI runs off at intervals of about 10 seconds by pressing button (10).

qa_pairs.question: How many oil services does the BMW 524 td have between each inspection?
qa_pairs.answer: The BMW 524 td has two OIL SERVICES between each inspection.

qa_pairs.question: What happens when you perform a brief reset (8) on the oil service indicator?
qa_pairs.answer: Brief reset (8) will cancel the display. All five green LEDs come on.

qa_pairs.question: How do you reset the inspection indicator and what happens?
qa_pairs.answer: Resetting 'INSPECTION' shows the 'INSPECTION' sign and yellow (possibly red) LED on. Long reset (9) will cancel the display.

qa_pairs.question: What is the effect of a long reset (9) on the time counter?
qa_pairs.answer: The time counter is not influenced! Time counter can be reset with a second reset (9).

qa_pairs.question: How do you reset the time symbol and distance counter?
qa_pairs.answer: Long reset (9) will cancel the time symbol and time counter. Distance counter can be reset with a second reset (9).

qa_pairs.question: What visual indicators show when resetting the 'TIME SYMBOL'?
qa_pairs.answer: 'TIME SYMBOL' and one or more green LEDs on. Green LEDs are not influenced!
